definitions.explanation: Someone who has just joined an organization, started a job, or entered a field.

⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新人|しんじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧だ。
examples.english: This year's new employees are excellent.

notes:
{新人|しんじん} refers to someone who has just entered a company, organization, or profession. It carries a neutral to positive connotation, implying freshness and potential.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新人|しんじん}⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: new employee
- {新人|しんじん}⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: new employee training
- {新人|しんじん}⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧: new singer
- {新人|しんじん}⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: newcomer award, rookie award
- {新人|しんじん}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: training for newcomers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新人|しんじん}: newcomer (emphasizes being new)
- ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}→新入：11503_shinnyuu⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: newly hired employee (more formal, workplace-specific)
- ⟦ルーキー→ルーキー：27859_ruukii⟧: rookie (loanword, mainly used in sports)
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧: senior (opposite in hierarchy)
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧: junior
- ⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧: veteran (opposite in experience)

In Japanese workplaces, {新人|しんじん} status typically lasts through the first year of employment.
